annotation.title_clean: 「臺灣 AI 行動計畫 2.0」於 114 年度預計投入 157 億餘元,允宜建置統籌檢討機制並完善 AI 法制作業,以強化各細部計畫之鏈結,俾達成厚植 AI 國力目標
annotation.title_en: Taiwan AI Action Plan 2.0: NT$15.7 billion planned for FY2025; a coordinating review mechanism and AI legislation should be established to strengthen links among sub-plans
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Control Yuan / Audit authority (Taiwan) – review of central government budget
annotation.venue: Audit report on FY2025 central government budget (Taiwan)
annotation.summary_en: Taiwan government review of the Taiwan AI Action Plan 2.0 (NT$15.75 billion budgeted for 2025). It finds no overall performance review across ministries, and urges a cross-ministry coordinating mechanism, faster enactment of the AI Basic Act, and better power infrastructure and AI talent supply.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establish a cross-ministry coordinating review mechanism for AI Action Plan 2.0 sub-plans
Expedite legislation of the draft AI Basic Act (18 articles, principle-based), pending since 2019
AI power demand to rise about 8x by 2028, so infrastructure must be strengthened
Strengthen AI talent via on-the-job training and industry-academia cooperation
FY2025 budget NT$15.748 billion, up 29.9% from FY2024
